about: Brand wording for the Glossary collection (English), from the Momos Marketing Brand Guide, 01 · tone of voice: guests, not customers; agent, never assistant or copilot; resolves, not replies; sentence case. Each phrase is an exact, case-sensitive edit chosen by hand: a 'customer' in a quoted study, another company's policy or wording, an industry name or metric, an 'also called' synonym, a case-study figure or a search-style FAQ question stays as it is. Term names go to sentence case where the article already writes them that way; names in keepNames keep their capitals.
